text.translation: Hya-hya-hya!{WAIT} Did you truly think I would join you?

text.reference: {race}が、{n}人間に頭を下げたとあっちゃァ、{n}末代までの恥じゃけェの。
text.translation: If {race} bowed to a human, the shame would haunt our clan for generations.

text.reference: まァ、これくらいはしてもええじゃろ。{n}ほれ、{BEAT}{offered_item}じゃ。{n}{BEAT}とっとけェ。
text.translation: Still, I can do this much. Here,{BEAT} take{BEAT} {offered_item}.

text.reference: 人生、そんなに甘かァねえぞォ～。
text.translation: Life isn't that easy!

text.reference: おぉ、{BEAT}おぉ、満月かい。{n}{WAIT}風流だのゥ。
text.translation: Ohh,{BEAT} ohh, a full moon.{WAIT} How refined.

text.reference: おまえさん、月にはうさぎが住んどるのを、{n}知っちょるか？{n}{WAIT}あのうさぎたちゃァ、大変じゃのゥ。
text.translation: Did you know rabbits live on the moon?{WAIT} Those rabbits have a terribly hard life.

text.reference: 毎夜、もちをつき通しでのゥ。
text.translation: They pound rice cakes every night without rest.

text.reference: 確かに
text.translation: That's true

text.reference: 月にうさぎはいない
text.translation: There are no rabbits on the moon

text.reference: だからどうした
text.translation: So what?

text.reference: そうじゃろ、そうじゃろ。{n}{WAIT}よく見ればおまえさんも、{n}つらそうな事をしておるのゥ。
text.translation: Indeed, indeed.{WAIT} Looking closely, you seem to have a difficult task of your own.

text.reference: どうれ。{n}{WAIT}わしが、いっちょう手伝ってやるか。
text.translation: Come now.{WAIT} Perhaps I'll lend you a hand.

text.reference: おまえさん、会った事があるんかァ！？{n}{WAIT}たわけッ！
text.translation: You've met them?!{WAIT} You fool!

text.reference: 見てもいないのに、{n}見て来た様な事を言うでない！！
text.translation: Don't speak as though you've seen something you haven't!

text.reference: なんじゃ、だまされんか。{n}もう、すっかり大人じゃのゥ。
text.translation: What, you didn't fall for it? You're all grown up now.

text.reference: ならば、ついて行ってやってもいいかのゥ。
text.translation: In that case, perhaps I'll accompany you.

text.reference: なんちゅう事を！{n}{WAIT}この、{BEAT}バチ当たりがァ！！
text.translation: What a disgrace!{WAIT} You{BEAT} godless wretch!

text.reference: おぉ、{BEAT}おぉ。{n}{WAIT}豪気な若もんじゃのゥ。{n}{WAIT}わしの若い頃に、そっくりじゃァ。
text.translation: Ohh,{BEAT} ohh.{WAIT} What a bold youngster.{WAIT} You're just like I was in my youth.

text.reference: どうれ。{n}{WAIT}わしが、めんどう見てやろう。
text.translation: Come now.{WAIT} I'll look after you.

text.reference: たわけッ。{n}それが、目上のもんに口をきく態度かァ！{n}{WAIT}年寄りの言う事は、聞くもんじゃァ！！
text.translation: You fool! Is that any way to address your elders?{WAIT} You should listen to what old people tell you!

text.reference: おぉ、{BEAT}おぉ、{BEAT}満月かい。{n}{WAIT}風流じゃのゥ。{n}月見としゃれこもうかのゥ。
text.translation: Ohh,{BEAT} ohh,{BEAT} a full moon.{WAIT} How refined. Shall we admire it together?

text.reference: これ若いの、{BEAT}こっち来てダンゴでも食え。
text.translation: Come here, young one,{BEAT} and have a dumpling.

text.reference: お言葉に甘える
text.translation: Accept his offer

text.reference: おぉ、{BEAT}おぉ。{n}{WAIT}わびさびのわかる奴じゃァ。
text.translation: Ohh,{BEAT} ohh.{WAIT} You appreciate life's subtleties.

text.reference: ついて行ってやるのも、一興かのゥ。
text.translation: Accompanying you might be rather diverting.

text.reference: ばかめェ。{n}{WAIT}わしの笑いダンゴを喰ろうて、{n}正気でいた奴はおらん！
text.translation: Fool!{WAIT} No one has ever eaten my laughing dumpling and kept their wits!

text.reference: 行くぞォ、{BEAT}ハナタレェ！！
text.translation: Here I come,{BEAT} you snot-nosed brat!

text.reference: ばかめェ。{n}{WAIT}わしの眠りダンゴを喰ろうて、{n}正気でいた奴はおらん！
text.translation: Fool!{WAIT} No one has ever eaten my sleeping dumpling and kept their wits!

text.reference: ばかめェ。{n}{WAIT}わしのシビレダンゴを喰ろうて、{n}正気でいた奴はおらん！
text.translation: Fool!{WAIT} No one has ever eaten my numbing dumpling and kept their wits!

text.reference: なんじゃ。{n}甘いもんは、嫌いか？{n}{WAIT}なら、これでカレーでも食べんしゃい。
text.translation: What, you don't like sweets?{WAIT} Then use this to buy yourself some curry.

text.reference: {offered_item}じゃァ。{n}気が変わらんうちに、とっとけェ。
text.translation: It's {offered_item}. Take it before I change my mind.

text.reference: なんじゃァ！{n}わしのダンゴが食えんっちゅうのは、{n}その口かァ！
text.translation: What?! Is that the mouth that refuses my dumplings?!

text.reference: その口なのかァ！！
text.translation: Is that the mouth?!

text.reference: 物騒な格好をして歩いちょるのゥ。{n}恐ろしいものよのゥ。
text.translation: Walking around armed like that... What a frightening sight.

text.reference: それでわしを殺そうっちゅうんかァ？
text.translation: Do you mean to kill me with it?

text.reference: 誤解だ
text.translation: You've misunderstood

text.reference: ひえぇぇぇ……{n}くわばら、くわばら。
text.translation: Eeeek... Heaven preserve me.

text.reference: 仲魔にでもなんでも、なるけェ。{n}お茶くみでもなんでも、するけェ。{n}{WAIT}助けてくれェ。
text.translation: I'll join you, I'll do anything. I'll even pour your tea.{WAIT} Just spare me!

text.reference: 月よ、わしに味方せい！{n}{WAIT}この小わっぱ、{n}{BEAT}生かしておいては、世のためにならんッ！！
text.translation: Moon, lend me your strength!{WAIT} This little whelp must{BEAT} not be allowed to live!

text.reference: おぉ、{BEAT}おぉ。{n}{WAIT}それじゃあ、{n}悪いもんを倒すための、備えかい。
text.translation: Ohh,{BEAT} ohh.{WAIT} So you're armed to defeat evildoers?

text.reference: かっこええのゥ。{n}{WAIT}よしッ、{BEAT}わしも一緒に暴れちゃる！！
text.translation: How dashing.{WAIT} Very well,{BEAT} I'll run wild alongside you!

text.reference: 年寄りをあなどるでない。{n}お見通しじゃァ！
text.translation: Do not underestimate your elders. I see through you!

text.reference: この目で、悪魔を殺しちょるのを、{n}見たけんのゥ。
text.translation: I saw you killing demons with my own eyes.

text.reference: くおらァ、ハナタレェ！！
text.translation: Why, you snot-nosed brat!

text.reference: わしの寝ぐらで悪さをするのは、{n}その手かァ！？
text.translation: Is that the hand causing trouble in my home?!

text.reference: その手なのかァ！？
text.translation: Is that the hand?!

text.reference: なんか文句あるか
text.translation: Got a problem?

text.reference: おぉ、{BEAT}おぉ。{n}{WAIT}ちと態度はでかいが、反省しちょるわ。{n}人間、素直がいちばんじゃァ。
text.translation: Ohh,{BEAT} ohh.{WAIT} Your attitude is a little grand, but you are reflecting on your behavior. Honesty is the finest virtue.

text.reference: もう悪さをせんように、{n}お守をしてやろうかのゥ。
text.translation: Perhaps I should look after you, to keep you from causing any more trouble.

text.reference: なんじゃ。{n}悪さをする奴を、{n}こらしめる人だったんかァ。
text.translation: What? So you punish those who cause trouble?

text.reference: かっこええのゥ。{n}{WAIT}よっしゃ。{n}{WAIT}わしも一緒に暴れちゃる。
text.translation: How dashing.{WAIT} All right.{WAIT} I'll run wild alongside you.

text.reference: ！{BEAT}！{n}{WAIT}ありません。
text.translation: !{BEAT}!{WAIT} None!

text.reference: 困ったのゥ。{n}{WAIT}仲魔になってやりたいのは、{n}やまやまなんじゃが。
text.translation: This is difficult.{WAIT} I would dearly like to join you, but...

text.reference: 仲魔の方々と、ソリが合わんようじゃァ。{n}{WAIT}かんにんしとくれェ。
text.translation: It seems I would not get along with your allies.{WAIT} Please forgive me.
text.note: Closing fragment for message 536; with dialogue_0500, the full line is: I would dearly like to join you, but it seems I would not get along with your allies. Please forgive me.

text.reference: {offered_item}を、やるけェ。{n}{WAIT}達者でのゥ。
text.translation: I'll give you {offered_item}.{WAIT} Farewell.

text.reference: 仲魔の方々と、ソリが合わんようじゃァ。{n}かんにんしとくれェ。{n}{WAIT}達者でのゥ。
text.translation: It seems I would not get along with your allies. Please forgive me.{WAIT} Farewell.
text.note: Closing fragment for message 537; with dialogue_0500, the full line is: I would dearly like to join you, but it seems I would not get along with your allies. Please forgive me. Farewell.

text.reference: むゥ、{BEAT}やはりやめておこうかのゥ。{n}{WAIT}ここでわしが力を貸したら、{n}おまえさんが、楽をしてしまう。
text.translation: Hmm,{BEAT} perhaps I should reconsider.{WAIT} If I lent you my strength now, life would become too easy for you.

text.reference: 「おんぶにだっこ」になりかねんからの。{n}若いうちは、苦労せにゃァ。
text.translation: You might come to rely on others for everything. The young must endure hardship.

text.reference: {offered_item}を、やるけェ。{n}{WAIT}もうちっと修行を積んでから、{n}また声をかけてくれェ。
text.translation: I'll give you {offered_item}.{WAIT} Train a little longer, then ask me again.

text.reference: もうちっと修行を積んでから、{n}また声をかけてくれェ。
text.translation: Train a little longer, then ask me again.

text.reference: オォオォ満月かい風流じゃのゥ
text.translation: Ohhh, a full moon. How refined.

text.reference: おぉ、{BEAT}おぉ。{n}{WAIT}こんなジジィをいじめて、楽しいかィ。{n}無駄な殺生はァ、するもんじゃねェぞ。
text.translation: Oh,{BEAT} oh.{WAIT} Do you enjoy tormenting an old man like me? You shouldn't kill without cause.

text.reference: {offered_item}を、やるけェ。{n}{WAIT}なッ、{BEAT}なッ。
text.translation: I'll give you {offered_item}.{WAIT} So,{BEAT} spare me.

text.reference: もう おまえさんしか見えないんじゃァ♡
text.translation: You are all I see now, young one...{heart_symbol}

text.reference: ヒャッヒャ～！ ウヒャヒャッヒャ～！！
text.translation: Hya-hya! U-hya-hya-hya!!

text.reference: わしのメガネ どこやったァ！？
text.translation: Where'd I put my glasses?!

text.reference: カンニンブクロのオッポが切れたぞォ！
text.translation: My patience has run out!

text.reference: ちと おきゅうをすえてやろうかのゥ
text.translation: Perhaps I'll teach you a lesson...

text.reference: これも定めじゃけェ カンニンしてくれェ
text.translation: Such is fate. Forgive me, young one.

text.reference: オォオォ 満月かい 風流じゃのゥ
text.translation: Ohh, ohh. A full moon? How refined.
